responsibility: Declares helper functions and macros for implementing debug dump methods throughout the diagnostics subsystem. It provides the common emitters for indented headings and scalar fields that are reused by buffers, sinks, file caches, and option structures when producing diagnostic-internal state dumps for debugging or selftest support.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the dumping pair: it exposes the dump-formatting helper functions and the convenience macro used by other diagnostics classes to implement dump methods. Unlike dumping.cc, it contains no formatting logic bodies.
